title: Evolved Virtual Creatures (1994)
summary: A restored 1994 video of Karl Sims' research on evolved virtual creatures, where simulated block creatures are bred through artificial evolution to swim, walk, follow and compete. It is a landmark demonstration of genetic algorithms in physics simulation.
why: HN brings it up as a classic example of evolutionary algorithms, including how the creatures exploited physics-simulation bugs, which parallels metric gaming in AI.

quote.text: they would absolutely exploit any bugs in the physics simulation that they could
